name: employee-plus
description: A consumer home-care concierge that helps organize maintenance, compare synthetic service options and manage appointments.
shortDescription: Organize home maintenance, compare service options and manage visits with Employee+.
fullDescription: Employee+ is a consumer home-care concierge. Ask what your home needs this week, compare synthetic service options, check availability, prepare a booking, confirm it explicitly, move only the date of an existing appointment, and retrieve a simulated service document. Providers, addresses and transactions are synthetic for this hackathon demo. Employee+ does not process payments, tax filings, identity verification, biometrics, video, audio or lock controls.
examplePhrases: Ask Employee Plus what my home needs this week.
Ask Employee Plus to compare repair options.
Ask Employee Plus to move my service appointment.
Ask Employee Plus for my service document.
